tools.description: Validate the text of an EVE-NG .unl lab: orphan nodes, dangling interfaces, partitions, forbidden role adjacency, single points of failure, link symmetry, and optional requirements (required_links, forbidden_links, redundancy_groups as JSON). Returns PASS/WARN/FAIL lists and a resilience level. Pass the file CONTENT, not a path. Node names in the result come from the file (untrusted).
tools.name: validate_unl_topology
